title: Angola Stock Exchange opens with BFA leading the way
description: The Luanda Stock Exchange opened with Banco de Fomento Angola (BFA) leading the way among listed shares.
imageAlt: Angola Stock Exchange opens with BFA leading the way
lead: The Luanda Stock Exchange opened with Banco de Fomento Angola (BFA) leading the way among listed shares, marking a new chapter for Angola's capital market.

body.text: The listing reinforces the confidence of international investors in Angola's financial market. For a Private Equity firm specialized in the oil & gas sector, the development of the capital market opens new doors for financing exploration and production projects.

body.alt: The Luanda Stock Exchange trading floor
body.caption: The Luanda Stock Exchange trading floor.

body.text: Capital markets and the energy sector

Sooil Services welcomes this milestone as further evidence of Angola's commitment to attracting investment into its most vital industry, where diversified access to capital is essential for the sustainable growth of the sector.
The development of Angola's capital market is key to financing the future of our oil industry.
A deeper capital market also benefits the communities that depend on the energy industry, enabling long-term projects in infrastructure, training and social development.

title: Luele expects to produce eight million carats
description: The largest diamond mine in the world delivering significant volumes for the country.
imageAlt: Luele expects to produce eight million carats
lead: The largest diamond mine in the world is delivering significant volumes for the country, confirming Angola as a leading producer of high-quality diamonds.

body.text: Production at the Luele mine continues to ramp up, with expectations of reaching eight million carats per year. The results reinforce the strength of Angola's mining sector beyond oil and gas.

body.caption: The Luele mine continues to ramp up production.

body.text: A diversified economy
For investors, the growth of the diamond industry offers new opportunities to participate in Angola's economic transformation, complementing the energy sector.
Mining and energy together are the pillars of Angola's economic future.
Sooil Services follows these developments closely, building a portfolio that reflects the growing diversity of the country's economy.

title: Huíla collects 17 billion in tax revenue in nine months
description: Tax revenue growth strengthening the province and its public services.
imageAlt: Huíla collects 17 billion in tax revenue in nine months
lead: Tax revenue growth strengthening the province and its public services.

body.text: In the first nine months of the year, the province of Huíla collected close to 17 billion in tax revenue, a result that confirms the growth of its economic activity.

body.caption: The province of Huíla continues to see strong economic growth.

body.text: Investment in public services
Higher revenue allows the province to invest in health, education and infrastructure, creating better conditions for families and for business.
Sustainable public finances are the foundation of regional development.
The result reflects the continued dynamism of Angola's regions and the work of local institutions to broaden the tax base.

title: News from the oil & gas sector
description: Follow the latest developments in Angola's oil industry.
imageAlt: News from the oil and gas sector
lead: Follow the latest developments in Angola's oil industry.

body.text: Angola's oil and gas sector continues to attract international investment, with producing fields, refining projects and new opportunities on the horizon.

body.caption: Exploration and production remain central to Angola's economy.

body.text: Opportunities in producing fields
For Private Equity investors, producing fields offer predictable cash flows and the chance to increase recovery rates with modern technology.
The most reliable opportunities are in the fields that are already producing.
Stay tuned for regular updates on projects, results and market developments across the Angolan energy landscape.

title: Deep-water block tender attracts international majors
description: International oil companies are lining up for Angola's deep-water block licensing round.
imageAlt: Deep-water block tender attracts international majors
lead: International oil companies are lining up ahead of Angola's upcoming deep-water block licensing round, a sign of sustained confidence in the country's offshore potential.

body.text: The licensing round covers several deep-water blocks with significant untapped potential. The level of interest from international operators confirms the competitive strength of Angola's offshore basins.

body.caption: Deep-water blocks continue to attract international operators.

body.text: A new cycle of exploration
For private investors, a cycle of new drilling and appraisal activity opens doors for structured financing across the exploration value chain.
Renewed exploration today builds the producing fields of tomorrow.
Sooil Services follows the licensing calendar closely, mapping opportunities for investment capital in the country's most strategic assets.

title: Angola expands refining capacity at Lobito
description: New refining projects strengthen fuel security and diversify downstream revenues.
imageAlt: Angola expands refining capacity at Lobito
lead: Angola is moving ahead with refining projects around Lobito, strengthening fuel security and diversifying downstream revenues.

body.text: The expansion of refining capacity reduces dependence on imported fuels and creates new industrial activity along the coast, from construction to logistics.

body.caption: Refining projects strengthen the downstream value chain.

body.text: Beyond crude exports
Downstream projects represent a growing segment for structured financing, with long-term contracts and predictable cash flows.
Adding value at home multiplies the benefit of every barrel produced.
Sooil Services tracks these investments as part of a broader view of Angola's energy value chain.

title: Natural gas takes centre stage in Angola's energy transition
description: Gas projects support the energy transition while opening new revenue streams.
imageAlt: Natural gas takes centre stage in Angola's energy transition
lead: Natural gas is taking centre stage in Angola's energy transition, supporting cleaner power generation and opening new revenue streams.

body.text: Associated gas and non-associated gas projects are gaining momentum, with new infrastructure connecting production to power plants and export markets.

body.caption: Gas infrastructure supports cleaner energy and new exports.

body.text: A bridge to a cleaner mix
Gas offers a lower-emission path for power generation while LNG exports bring new revenue to the country, attracting international capital.
Gas is the bridge between today's energy realities and tomorrow's cleaner mix.
Sooil Services sees the gas agenda as one of the most promising fronts for private capital in the coming years.

title: Cabinda leads new investment cycle in oil infrastructure
description: Investment in oil infrastructure in Cabinda supports regional development.
imageAlt: Cabinda leads new investment cycle in oil infrastructure
lead: Cabinda is leading a new investment cycle in oil infrastructure, reinforcing its position at the heart of Angola's oil production.

body.text: Upgrades to pipelines, storage and supporting facilities are extending the life of mature fields and preparing the province for new developments.

body.caption: Infrastructure investment supports mature fields and local jobs.

body.text: Local value and jobs
Beyond production volumes, the investment cycle brings local contracts, training and services that benefit surrounding communities.
Infrastructure investment is investment in people.
Sooil Services continues to assess opportunities in the province, where infrastructure and production go hand in hand.
